scope: Simulation and firmware compilation only. No synthesis, bitstream generation/loading or board access.

compiled_source_equivalence.change: trailing whitespace only; token sequence unchanged

characterization.purpose: Physical-window characterization; failure points retained, not passing regressions

limitations: No routed STA or board verification.
Slow/custom stage timings can increase cycles; only main/default performance is required and verified unchanged.
Raw/Q1/Q2/sample offsets are not universally valid for all target return delays.
Legacy DesignStart AHB FAULT model limitation retained; wire/control error tests cover FAULT.
